evidence: The crystalline structure and density of the In2O3 thin films were investigated via glancing angle X-ray diffraction (GAXRD, SmartLab, Rigaku) and XRR, respectively. The chemical characteristics of the In2O3 films were determined through X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS, K-Alpha, Thermo Scientific). The optical transmittances and refractive indices of the films were recorded via ultraviolet-visible (UV-Vis) spectrophotometry (UV-1800, Shimadzu) and spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE, Horiba Jobin Yvon UVISEL), respectively. Hall measurements (HMS-5000, Ecopia) were performed to determine the carrier concentrations, Hall mobilities, and resistivities of the In2O3 films grown at different deposition temperatures.
